children: RNS Number : 0131D  Corilis Digital Infrastructure Ltd  13 November 2026

Cordiant Digital Infrastructure Limited (the “Company”), the FTSE 250 specialist investor in and operator of digital infrastructure, today confirms that its name has been changed to Corilis Digital Infrastructure Limited.
Trading in the Company's ordinary shares under the new company name is expected to commence at 8.00 a.m. on 13 November 2026.
The Company's ticker symbol (CORD), ISIN (GG00BMC7TM77), SEDOL (BMC7TM7) and Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) (213800T8RBBWZQ7FTF84) remain unchanged.

Shareholder documents of title will be unaffected by the change of name and existing share certificates should be retained and remain valid. Any new share certificates to be issued will bear the new name, Corilis Digital Infrastructure Limited.

To reflect the Company's new name, the Company's corporate website address will be changed to https://www.corilisdigitaltrust.com/. Shareholders should take note that temporarily, the old website is still accessible.

Corilis Digital Infrastructure Limited is a closed-ended alternative investment fund listed on the London Stock Exchange (ticker: CORD), investing in digital infrastructure assets including data centres, communication towers and fibre optic networks, primarily in Europe and North America. The fund is classified as an alternative investment fund for the purposes of the UK’s alternative investment fund managers regime and is governed by an independent board of directors. Further details about the Company can be found on its website at https://www.corilisdigitaltrust.com/.
